title: "BE-PIN Dataset Inventory"
output: github_document
always_allow_html: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(here)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r load-data}
# Adjust the path below if your .Rmd lives somewhere other than
# the same folder as data.json

data <- fromJSON(here("data", "data_sources.json"), flatten = TRUE)
datasets <- data$datasets
```

```{r clean-data}
# Some fields (institution, source, linkURL, contactInfo) can be
# Collapse any list-columns into single comma-separated strings.
datasets <- datasets %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.list), ~ sapply(., function(x) {
    if (length(x) == 0 || all(x == "")) return("")
    paste(x, collapse = ", ")
  })))

# Recode the 0/1 flags as Yes/No for readability
datasets <- datasets %>%
  mutate(
    isCovid    = ifelse(isCovid == 1, "Yes", "No"),
    isBelgium  = ifelse(isBelgium == 1, "Yes", "No"),
    isActive   = ifelse(isActive == 1, "Yes", "No")
  )

# Truncate long free-text fields so the table stays narrow.
# Full descriptions remain in data_sources.json if needed.
truncate_text <- function(x, n = 100) {
  ifelse(nchar(x) > n, paste0(substr(x, 1, n), "..."), x)
}

datasets <- datasets %>%
  mutate(
    shortDescription = truncate_text(shortDescription, 100),
    # Turn the first link into a short "View" hyperlink instead of
    # printing the full URL
    linkURL = ifelse(
      linkURL == "" | is.na(linkURL),
      "",
      paste0("[View](", sub(",.*", "", linkURL), ")")
    )
  )
```


```{r full-table}
datasets %>%
  select(
    ID = id,
    Name = name,
    Type = type,
    Institution = institution,
    Category = category,
    `Detail Level` = detailLevel,
    Accessibility = accessibility,
    `Update Frequency` = updateFrequency,
    `COVID specific` = isCovid,
    `Belgium specific` = isBelgium,
    Active = isActive,
     `Short Description` = shortDescription,
        Link = linkURL
  ) %>%
  kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = TRUE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
                font_size = 4) %>%
    row_spec(0:nrow(datasets), extra_css = "padding: 1px 2px;") %>%
  column_spec(4, width = "20%") %>%   # Short Description gets more room
  column_spec(5, width = "10%")       # Institution

```
